# Hydromedon
 
> Hydromedon is an independent cinematic worship music project by composer Thierry Dubois, published under Soundscape Records, LLC. The debut album Biblical Graffiti (2026) contains 8 original faith-rooted compositions available on all major streaming platforms. The project also sells sheet music (lead sheets and full scores) and original merchandise at hydromedon.com and store.hydromedon.com.
 
Hydromedon music is cinematic, faith-rooted, and written for the searching soul. Songs draw from Psalms, Ephesians, Isaiah, Numbers, and Philippians. Sheet music is available for worship teams, musicians, and music directors.
 
All compositions and recordings are © Soundscape Records, LLC. Sync and master rights are held by Soundscape Records, LLC — one license covers both.
 
## Music
 
- [Biblical Graffiti — Album overview](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/biblical-graffiti): Full album with 8 original compositions, release notes, and streaming links
- [Arise, O Lord](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/arise-o-lord): Single — Psalm of deliverance and spiritual warfare. Key: C# major, 121 BPM
- [Armor of Light](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/armor-of-light): Single — Ephesians 6 spiritual armor anthem. Key: Bb major, 76 BPM
- [Beauty for Ashes](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/beauty-for-ashes): Single — Isaiah 61 song of renewal. Key: G major, 72 BPM
- [Change Me, Mold Me, Make Me New](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/change-me-mold-me-make-me-new): Single — Prayer of transformation. Key: F major, 68 BPM
- [Make a Way](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/make-a-way): Single — Song of trust and divine provision. Key: D major, 80 BPM
- [The Lord Bless You and Keep You](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/the-lord-bless-you-and-keep-you): Single — Numbers 6:24-26 benediction. Key: E major, 105 BPM
- [Under Your Wings](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/under-your-wings): Single — Psalm 91 refuge and safety. Key: A major, 74 BPM
- [Your Peace Surpasses All Understanding](https://www.hydromedon.com/music/your-peace-surpasses-all-understanding): Single — Philippians 4 meditation. Key: G major, 76 BPM

## Licensing
 
- [Licensing page](https://www.hydromedon.com/licensing): Per-song and full-album licenses for church/worship ($19.95), online video ($29.95), and film/TV/commercial ($99.95). Biblical Graffiti album bundles also available. One license covers both sync and master rights.
